note: An unusually thin day for data stories, two days before the Oct 27 election: of 448 new unique top-20 headlines across the 7 reachable outlets with fresh items (ynet, n12, walla, kan, haaretz, themarker, i24; globes had no new unique top-20 items in this window; israelhayom/ch14/makorrishon/calcalist remained blocked from this runner per CLAUDE.md known-blocked list), the overwhelming majority were election-eve political coverage, campaign rallies, the Hebron military operation and associated fatalities, European unrest, and the Brazil election runoff — none carrying a citable source with a specific empirical claim in scope. 6 stories were selected for audit, including one genuine cross-outlet cluster (RAMA vs. Education Minister Kish over international-test participation and leaked Meitzav scores, carried independently by haaretz/themarker - same underlying article - plus separate N12 and Walla pieces). The other five are single-outlet science/health/finance items with a clear citable source: bank trading-fee revenue (TheMarker), a Nature Medicine walking/Alzheimer-biomarker study and a European Urology prostate-cancer blood-test study (both ynet/health), a Tel Aviv University amber-fossil paleontology finding (Haaretz), and a Slovak Tourism Board visitor-count claim (N12/mako).
